Cannibal King is a July, 1915 American silent comedy film starring Oliver Hardy. It was shown on a split reel following a cartoon comedy called Ping Pong Woo. The copyright was registered at the Library of Congress under Ping Pong Woo.Lubin Manufacturing Company. Ping Pong Woo. Motion Picture Copyright Descriptions Collection. Class M, -1977. 1915. Manuscript/Mixed Material. .
